heading: Atlantis NDT — Non-Destructive Testing Services, Training, Consulting & Software
intro: Atlantis NDT is a founder-led non-destructive testing company delivering inspection services, NDT training and certification, ASNT Level III consulting, and purpose-built inspection software. Founded and led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III in five methods (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT) with 11+ years of international NDT field experience. The company has offices in Houston, Texas and Hyderabad, India, and delivers work remotely, online, or on-site at the client's facility. Its Level III-led consulting covers ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant and visual testing for oil & gas, aerospace, marine, power generation and manufacturing.

paragraphs: NDT Training & Certification — Level I, II, and III courses per ASNT SNT-TC-1A across UT, RT, MT, PT, ET, VT and advanced methods (PAUT, TOFD), plus ASNT certification preparation. Theory is self-paced online with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions; practicals run in the Practical NDT simulator and in person at your facility.
ASNT Level III Consulting — outsourced Level III services, written practice development, procedure development and qualification, and code compliance across ASME, API, AWS, ISO, and EN standards.

Atlantis ERP — affordable, fully customizable NDT inspection management software built on integrated business apps: work orders, technician certification tracking, calibration management, quoting, invoicing, and NDT reporting software that turns field data into client-ready reports.

Digital Twins — an enterprise digital twin platform for asset integrity: 3D asset visualization, defect mapping, corrosion overlay, predictive analytics, and turnaround planning, delivered via web or VR/AR.

Beyond software and training, Atlantis NDT delivers field inspection services — corrosion mapping, phased array UT, tank floor MFL, and API 510/570/653 driven inspection programs — plus 3D laser scanning services using LiDAR, photogrammetry, and drone capture to build accurate as-built models of plants, tanks, and structures. Our NDT Connect marketplace links qualified inspectors with companies that need certified personnel, and our free resources library offers checklists, templates, and study guides authored by an ASNT NDT Level III.

Atlantis NDT has offices in Houston, Texas and Hyderabad, India, and delivers remotely, online, or on-site at the client's facility. The services are built for operators, fabricators, EPCs and inspection companies. Explore case studies, browse the NDT blog, or learn more about the company.
